name: isolated-devcontainers-suede
description: Dev-only manifest. NOT shipped -- release/ is the shipped tree and carries no package.json. Exists for two reasons: it pins ESM resolution for the .ts files node runs during tests, and it gives the suite memorable entry points.

scripts.lint:sh: shellcheck -S warning release/*.sh release/vm/*.sh release/proxy/vm/install.sh release/proxy/container/*.sh release/vscode-image/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/**/*.sh .devcontainer/*.sh
